candidate_relations.reason: The reference requires three composite components: (1) mirror-image dextrocardia, (2) acute inferior wall MI, and (3) right ventricular MI, all due to proximal RCA occlusion. C001 correctly identifies dextrocardia with situs inversus and proximal RCA occlusion but labels the event only as 'acute myocardial infarction' without specifying inferior wall and right ventricular territory, omitting required anatomical specificity present in the benchmark.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures dextrocardia, situs inversus context, and proximal RCA occlusion as AMI cause, but does not specify the anatomical territory (inferior wall) or the right ventricular involvement as explicit components of the infarction

case_quality_flags: ECG pattern (negative P in I, diminishing V1-V6 progression, ST elevations in I/II/III/aVF/V4-V6) and echo confirming cardiac situs inversus strongly support mirror-image dextrocardia; inferior and RV wall territory inferred from RCA occlusion and ST distribution
